dishes.name: Blue Prawn Salad
dishes.spielFull: Blue prawn salad with Caledonian blue prawns rubbed in a Szechuan-coriander blend and grilled, served over peppery greens with Japanese mizuna, tossed in our carrot ginger dressing. We finish it with crispy gobo chips, which are burdock root, and pickled tri-color cauliflower for crunch and a little tang. Light, refreshing salad with a bit of spice and texture.
dishes.spielShort: Grilled Caledonian blue prawns over peppery greens in carrot ginger dressing, finished with crispy gobo chips and pickled cauliflower. Light, refreshing, with a little spice and crunch.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Caledonian blue prawn

Peppery Greens: arugula, frisée, mizuna, watercress, butter lettuce

Blue Prawn Spice Rub: green pepper, white pepper, mustard seed, coriander seed, Szechuan pepper, dry miso, green togarashi

Carrot Ginger Dressing: EVOO, rice vinegar, amatoza, ginger juice, sriracha, shallots, ginger oroshi, garlic, carrot pulp, carrot juice, maldon salt, shiso leaves, white pepper

Garnish: Crispy gobo chips (burdock root), Pickled tri-color cauliflower
dishes.serviceNotes:
Greens differentiation: This uses the 'peppery greens blend' (arugula, frisée, mizuna, watercress, butter lettuce) — different from the 'spring mix style base' used for Field Greens, Sashimi Salad, Grilled Shiitake Salad, Lobster Salad.

Guest wording options: 'Peppery greens with Japanese mizuna' / 'Crisp greens with a gentle peppery bite' / 'Arugula and mizuna based greens'

dishes.name: Fluke Yuzu Salsa
dishes.buildPlating:
1. Base: Arrange nine thin slices of fluke sashimi on plate
2. Dress: Spoon yuzu cucumber serrano salsa over fish
3. Finish: Light drizzle of olive oil
4. Garnish: Top with micro cilantro
dishes.spielFull: Fluke sashimi, nine thin slices, dressed in a spiced citrus cucumber salsa with yuzu, lime, Meyer lemon, and a touch of serrano, finished with a light drizzle of olive oil and topped with micro cilantro. It is a very clean, refreshing sashimi plate with just a gentle hint of heat that sits beautifully between courses.
dishes.spielShort: Nine slices of fluke sashimi dressed in a yuzu cucumber serrano salsa, finished with olive oil and micro cilantro. Clean and refreshing with just a gentle hint of heat.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Fluke sashimi (nine thin slices)

Yuzu Cucumber Serrano Salsa:
- Ama Toza base (rice vinegar, sugar, salt, soy sauce, bonito, cayenne)
- Cucumber (diced)
- Lime juice
- Meyer lemon juice
- Yuzu juice
- Garlic (minced)
- Ginger (minced)
- Serrano (thin sliced)
- Olive oil

Garnish: Micro cilantro, Olive oil drizzle (added just before service)
dishes.serviceNotes:
Preparation timing: Add olive oil drizzle just before sending to keep the plate glossy and aromatic.
Serrano role: Used as an accent, not a dominant heat element.
Onion-free: This salsa intentionally contains no onion.

dishes.name: Kampachi Aji Panka
dishes.spielFull: Kampachi amberjack sashimi, six pieces. The sauce is a blend of Peruvian spicy red anticucho, sweet citrus miso, fresh aji amarillo pepper, and a house vinegar blend — we heat the vinegar blend just enough to draw out the vegetable flavors quickly, then mix all four components together. Sweet and savory with a little spice and a Japanese citrus note. Finished with crispy tofu skin, pickled sushi ginger, kaiware sprouts, diced red onion, and a sprinkle of soy salt.
dishes.spielShort: Kampachi sashimi with red anticucho, yuzu miso, fresh aji amarillo, and house vinegar blend — all mixed together. Finished with crispy yuba, pickled ginger, kaiware, and soy salt. Sweet, savory, a little spice.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Kampachi (amberjack) sashimi, 6 pieces

Red Anticucho Sauce: Grapeseed oil, rice vinegar, sake, aji panka, garlic, cumin, oregano, paprika, salt, black pepper

Yuzu Miso Sauce: Den miso, yuzu, lemon, lime, lemon zest

Fresh Aji Amarillo Pepper

House Vinegar Blend (heated to draw out flavor): Rice wine vinegar, white onion, black pepper, ginger, red chili flakes, garlic

Garnish: Crispy yuba (tofu skin), pickled sushi ginger, kaiware sprouts, diced red onion, soy salt
dishes.serviceNotes:
Vinegar Blend Technique: The house vinegar blend is heated (not boiled) before mixing. This draws out the vegetable flavors in minutes rather than letting it sit 3-4 days to develop. It's warmed just enough to release the aromatics from the onion, ginger, garlic, and chili.

All four sauce components (red anticucho, yuzu miso, aji amarillo, vinegar blend) are mixed together as a unified sauce.

dishes.name: Sawara Yuzu Kosho
dishes.spielFull: Six pieces of Spanish mackerel sashimi on fresh arugula, dressed with our house yuzu kosho — citrus forward and quite spicy dressing — with a touch of bonito infused sweet vinegar to balance it out. Each piece gets a dot of aji amarillo aioli, a slice of pickled red onion, and we finish with crispy rice cracker pearls to add a light texture. Bright, citrusy, peppery heat from the yuzu kosho with a fresh bite from the arugula — it eats like a light sashimi salad.
dishes.spielShort: Spanish mackerel on arugula with yuzu kosho dressing — citrus forward, pretty spicy. Finished with aji amarillo aioli, pickled onion, crispy rice cracker pearls. Light, fresh, sashimi salad style.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Sawara (Spanish mackerel) sashimi, 6 pieces

Base: Fresh arugula

Yuzu Kosho Dressing: Grapeseed oil, green chili, yuzu juice, yuzu kosho paste (yuzu, salt, green chili), honey

Amazu-Tosazu Blend (sushi kitchen blend without shichimi, drizzled on the side): Amazu (rice vinegar, sugar, salt), Tosazu (rice vinegar, bonito, soy sauce)

Pickled Red Onion: Pickling liquid is a blend of tosazu and amazu

Aji Amarillo Aioli: Mayo, lemon juice, lime juice, yuzu, aji amarillo, salt, cilantro

Garnish: Crispy rice cracker pearls
dishes.serviceNotes:
Wagyu version is identical build — just swap sawara for A5 wagyu.

Amazu-Tosazu Drizzle: This is a sushi kitchen blend (different from the kitchen amatoza). It's drizzled on the side of the plate in a small amount because the yuzu kosho dressing is quite salty — the drizzle balances the dish.

Eats like a light sashimi salad thanks to the arugula base and balanced dressing.

dishes.name: Wagyu Yuzu Kosho
dishes.spielFull: Six pieces of A5 wagyu sashimi on fresh arugula, dressed with our house yuzu kosho — citrus forward and quite spicy dressing — with a touch of bonito infused sweet vinegar to balance it out. Each piece gets a dot of aji amarillo aioli, a slice of pickled red onion, and we finish with crispy rice cracker pearls to add a light texture. Bright, citrusy, peppery heat from the yuzu kosho with a fresh bite from the arugula — it eats like a light sashimi salad.
dishes.spielShort: A5 wagyu on arugula with yuzu kosho dressing — citrus forward, pretty spicy. Finished with aji amarillo aioli, pickled onion, crispy rice cracker pearls. Light, fresh, sashimi salad style.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: A5 Wagyu, 2 ounces min

Base: Fresh arugula

Yuzu Kosho Dressing: Grapeseed oil, green chili, yuzu juice, yuzu kosho paste (yuzu, salt, green chili), honey

Amazu-Tosazu Blend (sushi kitchen blend without shichimi, drizzled on the side): Amazu (rice vinegar, sugar, salt), Tosazu (rice vinegar, bonito, soy sauce)

Pickled Red Onion: Pickling liquid is a blend of tosazu and amazu

Aji Amarillo Aioli: Mayo, lemon juice, lime juice, yuzu, aji amarillo, salt, cilantro

Garnish: Crispy rice cracker pearls
dishes.serviceNotes:
Same build as Sawara Yuzu Kosho — just swap sawara for A5 wagyu.

Amazu-Tosazu Drizzle: This is a sushi kitchen blend (different from the kitchen amatoza). It's drizzled on the side of the plate in a small amount because the yuzu kosho dressing is quite salty — the drizzle balances the dish.

Eats like a light sashimi salad thanks to the arugula base and balanced dressing.

dishes.name: Tai Relish
dishes.spielFull: Tai snapper sashimi wrapped around a crispy phyllo dough, set in a butter lettuce cup, topped with our house-made sweet Japanese relish of cucumber, zucchini, white onion, and celery, and a thin slice of jalapeño. Finished with a sprinkle of soy salt. Sweet, crisp and a little heat.
dishes.spielShort: Tai snapper wrapped around crispy phyllo in a butter lettuce cup, topped with house-made sweet Japanese relish and jalapeño, finished with soy salt. Bite-size, two piece minimum.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Tai snapper sashimi (wrapped around phyllo)

Structure: Crispy phyllo dough, Butter lettuce cup

House-Made Sweet Japanese Relish: Zucchini (diced), Japanese cucumber (diced), White onion (diced), Celery (diced), Salt

Relish Sauce (Heated then Chilled): Amazu (sweet rice vinegar), Ginger oroshi (grated ginger), Mustard seeds, Lemon slice

Garnish: Jalapeño (thin slice)

Finish: Soy salt
dishes.serviceNotes:
Minimum order: Two pieces.
Format: Bite-size, served by the piece.

Relish Preparation Method:
1. Combine vegetables (zucchini, cucumber, onion, celery) and salt
2. Combine pickling base (amazu, ginger oroshi, mustard seeds, lemon slice)
3. Heat vegetables and pickling base together in a pot until just at a boil
4. Remove from heat
5. Transfer to a jar, cool, and refrigerate until service

dishes.name: Tai Agave
dishes.spielFull: Six pieces of Japanese snapper sashimi in a sweet and spicy agave aji amarillo sauce with lemon and garlic, finished with fresh aji amarillo pepper to add even more heat, shaved celery hearts for a bit of crunch, and a sprinkle of black salt as a finishing touch. It is clean and bright with real heat and is one of the spiciest sashimi plates we serve, so it can be a bit of a challenge if you are sensitive to spice.
dishes.spielShort: Tai Agave is six pieces of Japanese snapper sashimi in a sweet and spicy agave aji amarillo sauce with lemon and garlic, finished with fresh aji amarillo pepper for extra heat, shaved celery hearts for crunch, and a sprinkle of black salt as a finishing touch.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Japanese snapper sashimi (six pieces)

Sweet and Spicy Agave Sauce: Aji amarillo paste, Garlic (minced), Lemon juice, Agave nectar, Salt

Garnishes: Fresh aji amarillo pepper (diced or thin sliced), Celery hearts (shaved), Black salt (sprinkle)
dishes.serviceNotes:
Portion: Six pieces.
Dietary advantage: Naturally soy-free and gluten-free.
One of the spiciest sashimi plates we serve.

dishes.name: Toro Yuzu Miso
dishes.spielFull: Toro sashimi, six pieces, lightly seared on the outside and sitting in a citrus sweet yuzu miso. The sauce is made with Japanese citrus and our house sweet den miso. On top of each slice there is just a tiny spoon of our house jalapeño salsa made from our signature jalapeño dressing, chopped red onion, and fresh serrano, then finished with caviar. So you get rich, buttery toro, a sweet savory citrus miso, and just a little bite and heat from the salsa and caviar to balance the richness. It is one of the more premium sashimi plates we offer and the yuzu miso has a deeper, richer sweetness compared with regular miso.
dishes.spielShort: Lightly seared toro sashimi in a citrus sweet yuzu miso, with a touch of house jalapeño salsa and caviar on each slice.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Toro (fatty tuna), six pieces, lightly seared

Citrus Sweet Yuzu Miso: Den miso (house sweet miso) - White miso, Sake, Mirin, Sugar; Yuzu, Lemon, Lime, Lemon zest

House Jalapeño Salsa (on each slice): Jalapeño dressing (grapeseed oil, rice vinegar, jalapeño, serrano, garlic), Chopped red onion, Fresh serrano

Finish: Caviar
dishes.serviceNotes:
Portion: Six pieces.
Sear: Light sear on the outside, raw center.
Salsa placement: Tiny spoon on each slice.
Caviar placement: On top of each individual sashimi slice.
Position: Premium sashimi offering.

dishes.name: Toro Wasabi Salsa
dishes.spielFull: Toro sashimi, six pieces, lightly seared on the outside and set in a ponzu sauce that we make in house with soy sauce, lemon, and rice vinegar. On top of each slice there is a small amount of wasabi salsa made with kizami wasabi and chopped red onion, then finished with micro cilantro. So you get rich, buttery toro with a light sear for warmth and texture, a bright citrus soy ponzu, clean wasabi heat, and a fresh green finish from the micro cilantro. It is a lighter, more citrus forward toro preparation compared with the yuzu miso version.
dishes.spielShort: Lightly seared toro sashimi in house made ponzu with a touch of wasabi salsa and micro cilantro on each slice.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Toro, fatty tuna sashimi, six pieces, lightly seared

Ponzu Sauce: Soy sauce, Lemon juice, Rice vinegar

Wasabi Salsa: Kizami wasabi (chopped wasabi condiment - wasabi, hydrolyzed vegetable protein, horseradish, soy sauce, food starch, water, sugar, canola oil, MSG, natural and artificial flavor, kelp extract, xanthan gum, spirulina, turmeric), Red onion (finely chopped)

Finish: Micro cilantro
dishes.serviceNotes:
Portion: Six pieces.
Sear: Light sear on the outside, raw center.
Salsa placement: Small amount on each slice.
Garnish: Micro cilantro on top.

Kizami wasabi is a prepared chopped wasabi condiment – real wasabi root finely chopped and marinated in soy sauce and seasonings. It eats like a soy-wasabi relish: sharp, clean wasabi heat with a salty, savory finish from the soy.

dishes.name: Salmon Sweet Onion
dishes.spielFull: Six pieces of salmon sashimi topped with our Sweet Onion Salsa, the same bright, savory sweet salsa we use for the taco dishes, then finished with a dot of aji amarillo aioli. Clean sashimi style, but with that taco inspired punch.
dishes.spielShort: Salmon sashimi topped with Sweet Onion Salsa and aji amarillo aioli. Bright, savory sweet, sashimi plate.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Salmon: Salmon sashimi (6 pieces)

Sweet Onion Salsa: Olive oil, Soy sauce, Ama toza, Soy mirin, Yuzu, Onion, Micro cilantro, Garlic puree, Chili d'agua

Aji Amarillo Aioli: Mayo, Lemon juice, Lime juice, Yuzu, Aji amarillo, Salt, Cilantro
dishes.serviceNotes: This is basically the taco flavor profile turned into a sashimi plate.

dishes.name: Whitefish Arugula
dishes.spielFull: Nine pieces of delicate fluke sashimi set in our signature jalapeño dressing, which is more garlicky and bright than it is spicy, with acidity from rice vinegar. Finished with sliced aged pecorino cheese on each piece and micro arugula for a fresh, peppery bite. It's a really balanced sashimi plate, clean and flavorful.
dishes.spielShort: Nine pieces of fluke sashimi in jalapeño dressing, topped with sliced aged pecorino cheese and finished with micro arugula. Delicate sashimi plate, garlicky and bright with a mild kick.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Fluke sashimi (9 slices)

Jalapeño Dressing: Grapeseed oil, Rice vinegar, Jalapeños, Serrano, Garlic

Finish: Aged pecorino cheese (sliced), Micro arugula
dishes.serviceNotes:
Guest-friendly positioning: 'not really spicy, more garlicky and bright.'
Optional variation: can be done with salmon sashimi (use only when it helps guide the guest).

dishes.name: Salmon Pastrami Rice Cakes
dishes.spielFull: Smoked salmon sashimi rubbed with our house-made pastrami seasoning, served on a crispy rice cake, then finished with wasabi shiso aioli, crispy capers, and a touch of red onion and cilantro. You get soft salmon against the crunch of the rice cake, peppery warmth from the pastrami spice, and a clean wasabi herb finish.
dishes.spielShort: Smoked salmon pastrami on a crispy rice cake, finished with wasabi shiso aioli and crispy capers, with a little red onion and cilantro.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Main: Smoked salmon sashimi, Crispy rice cake, Crispy capers

Wasabi Shiso Aioli (with cilantro and red onion): Base aioli - Mayo, Lemon juice, Lime juice, Yuzu juice, Wasabi, Shiso, Chives; Mixed in - Cilantro, Red onion

Pastrami Rub: Black peppercorn, White peppercorn, Coriander seeds, Mustard seeds, Minced garlic, Brown sugar, Paprika, Salt, Rocoto salt
dishes.serviceNotes: Portion: 2 pieces minimum.

dishes.name: Tai Truffle Special
dishes.spielFull: Six pieces of Japanese red snapper sashimi set in a bonito-infused, sweet-savory truffle yuzu soy. Topped with thinly sliced eryngii mushrooms and shaved black truffles, then finished with micro celery and a touch of white pepper. Aromatic and elegant, with clean citrus, savory depth, and that earthy truffle finish.
dishes.spielShort: Six pieces of tai sashimi in a bonito-infused sweet-savory truffle yuzu soy, topped with eryngii mushrooms and shaved black truffles, finished with micro celery and white pepper.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Tai sashimi (6 pieces)

Toppings and Finish: Eryngii mushrooms, Truffles (shaved), Micro celery, White pepper

Sauce: Truffle oil

Ama Toza: Rice vinegar, Sugar, Salt, Soy sauce, Bonito, Cayenne

Yuzu soy: Soy sauce, Yuzu juice

dishes.name: Tuna Cilantro Salad
dishes.spielFull: Bigeye tuna sashimi, seven pieces, dusted with salt and pepper and lightly seared on the outside, set around crisp peppery greens — arugula, mizuna, watercress, frisée, and butter lettuce — tossed with shaved daikon, finely diced ginger, finely diced serrano, and cilantro in a bright sesame tosazu dressing with fresh-squeezed Meyer lemon juice. Finished with black sesame seeds. Bright citrus, peppery greens, and a clean heat from serrano. Cilantro is a supporting note, not overpowering.
dishes.spielShort: Seven pieces of bigeye tuna, seared and set around peppery greens with daikon, ginger, serrano, and cilantro in sesame tosazu and Meyer lemon, finished with black sesame seeds.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Bigeye tuna sashimi (7 pieces), salt and pepper dusted, lightly seared on outside

Greens (Peppery Greens Blend): Arugula, Watercress, Frisée, Mizuna, Butter lettuce

Add-ins: Shaved daikon radish, Finely diced ginger, Finely diced serrano, Chopped cilantro

Sesame Tosazu Dressing: Tosazu (soy sauce, rice vinegar, bonito), Ama toza (rice vinegar, sugar, salt, soy sauce, bonito, cayenne), Grapeseed oil, Sesame oil

In the Bowl: Fresh-squeezed Meyer lemon juice

Garnish: Black sesame seeds
dishes.serviceNotes: Cilantro is a supporting note, not dominant.

dishes.name: Seiko Gani
dishes.spielFull: We have one of our more traditional Japanese dishes called Seiko Gani, a Japanese female snow crab that is prized in winter for its rich, flavorful eggs. We boil the whole crab, chill it, then pick the meat and eggs and present them back in the shell. On one side you have delicate sweet crab meat, on the other rich crab eggs. It is finished with a chilled tosazu jelly, which is a classic Japanese bonito infused sweet soy vinegar jelly. The flavor is sweet, savory, and gently tangy, just enough to highlight the natural flavor of the crab without overpowering it. It is fully cooked and served chilled, with a small shiso flower on top as an accent.
dishes.spielShort: Seasonal Japanese female snow crab, cooked and chilled, served back in the shell with sweet crab meat, rich crab eggs, and a light bonito infused sweet soy vinegar jelly.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Seiko Gani — Japanese female snow crab (1 pc per order)

Tosazu Jelly: 600g dashi, 150g Shiragiku Su rice vinegar, 100g mirin, 100g light soy sauce (usukuchi), 40g sugar, 15g gelatin

Garnish: Shiso flower (1 pc)

Portion: 1 pc boiled Seiko Gani, 80g tosazu jelly, 1 pc shiso flower
dishes.serviceNotes:
Seasonal Japanese winter specialty.
Female snow crab is prized for its rich roe and flavorful eggs.
Presentation: meat and eggs presented back in the shell, split visually.
Cold dish.
Shiso flower is an aromatic accent on top.
No extra seasoning on the crab — pure crab flavor.
Tosazu jelly: sweet, savory, and gently acidic rather than heavy.

dishes.name: King Salmon Rocoto
dishes.spielFull: Wild king salmon, sashimi grade, rubbed with Sichuan coriander and pan-seared in our house-made shiso rocoto butter with a splash of yuzu and lemon juice, cooked to medium rare. Served over crispy Brussels sprouts that are flash fried and seasoned simply with salt, finished with micro red shiso and Tokyo negi. Rich and savory, definitely on the spicy side, with just enough citrus to cut through and keep the focus on the wild king salmon.
dishes.spielShort: Wild king salmon, Sichuan coriander rubbed and pan-seared in shiso rocoto butter to medium rare, served with crispy Brussels sprouts. Micro red shiso, Tokyo negi.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Wild Alaskan king salmon, sashimi grade

Rub: Sichuan coriander

Shiso Rocoto Butter (house-made compound butter stick): Rocoto sriracha, Wasabi, Chopped shiso, Butter

Rocoto Sriracha: Fresh rocoto peppers (whole peppers, not paste), Fresno peppers, Garlic, Palm sugar, Salt, Vinegar

In the Pan: Yuzu juice (added in pan), Lemon juice (added in pan)

Crispy Brussels Sprouts: Flash fried, seasoned with salt only

Garnish: Micro red shiso, Tokyo negi
dishes.serviceNotes:
Sashimi grade salmon cooked to medium rare, so it will be slightly raw in the middle.
Definitely on the spicy side.
Uses Szechuan coriander rub.

Shiso Rocoto Butter is a house-made compound butter stick (not a sauce). The butter is made with rocoto sriracha, wasabi, and chopped shiso blended into actual butter. Yuzu juice and lemon juice are added separately in the pan during cooking — they are NOT part of the butter itself.

dishes.name: King Salmon Shiso Serrano
dishes.spielFull: Wild king salmon, sashimi grade, salt and pepper rubbed and pan-seared in butter to medium rare. It sits over shimeji and enoki mushrooms tossed in our sesame onion salsa. We finish it with shiso serrano sauce — our jalapeño dressing layered with fresh shiso and serrano — and top it with micro Japanese red shiso. Gentle heat rather than big spice, so it really highlights the flavor of the sashimi-grade wild king salmon.
dishes.spielShort: Wild king salmon, pan-seared in butter to medium rare, over shimeji and enoki mushrooms in sesame onion salsa, finished with shiso serrano jalapeño dressing and micro red shiso.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Wild Alaskan king salmon, sashimi grade

Rub: Salt and pepper

Cook: Pan-seared in butter to medium rare

Mushroom Base — Nobu Salsa (Sesame Onion Salsa): Shimeji mushrooms, Enoki mushrooms, Nobu Salsa: Maui onion, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, yuzu juice, ichimi togarashi, sugar

Shiso Serrano Sauce: Jalapeño dressing (grapeseed oil, rice vinegar, jalapeño, garlic, serrano), Chopped fresh shiso, Chopped serrano

Garnish: Micro red shiso
dishes.serviceNotes:
Sashimi grade salmon cooked to medium rare.
Gentle, flavorful spice - not as spicy as Rocoto.
Uses simple salt and pepper rub.

Jalapeño dressing does NOT contain soy — allergen update from prior notes.

dishes.name: King Salmon Yuzu Soy
dishes.spielFull: Wild king salmon, sashimi grade, salt and pepper dusted and pan-seared in butter to medium rare. Dressed with our signature citrus yuzu soy and finished with crispy spinach, garlic chips, a touch of sesame seeds, and pink peppercorn for gentle spice and texture. This is one of our classic Nobu signature dishes that used to be on the menu — very simple and clean, all to highlight the flavor of the wild king salmon.
dishes.spielShort: Wild king salmon, salt and pepper rubbed, pan-seared in butter to medium rare, dressed with yuzu soy, finished with crispy spinach, garlic chips, sesame seeds, and pink peppercorn. Classic Nobu signature.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Wild Alaskan king salmon, sashimi grade

Rub: Salt and pepper

Cook: Pan-seared in butter to medium rare

Sauce: Yuzu soy (signature citrus soy)

Garnish: Crispy spinach, Crispy garlic chips, Sesame seeds, Pink peppercorn
dishes.serviceNotes:
No spice option.
Classic Nobu signature dish.
Very simple and clean preparation.

dishes.name: Short Rib with Hearts of Palm Purée
dishes.spielFull: We slow-cook the short rib for 48 hours, dust it with our 11-spice blend, and finish it on the grill so the spices toast and the edges pick up a gentle char. It goes into the pan with shimeji and our sweet onion soy, and we glaze it until the meat is glossy and seasoned end to end. We plate over a silky hearts of palm purée with caramelized shallots, then finish with pickled asparagus for brightness.
dishes.spielShort: 48-hour sous vide short rib with our house 11-spice rub, grilled for a light char, then glazed in sweet onion soy with shimeji mushrooms. It sits on a silky hearts of palm purée with caramelized shallots, finished with pickled asparagus.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Short rib (48-hour sous vide)

11-Spice Dry Rub: Coriander seeds, White pepper, Nutmeg, Fennel pollen, Ginger, Curry, Cumin seeds, Cloves, Cayenne pepper, Paprika, Star anise, Cinnamon

Sweet Onion Soy (Glaze): Sugar, Ginger, Green onions, Maui onion, Fuji apple, Jalapeño, Garlic, Soy sauce, Sake, Sesame oil, Sesame seeds

Hearts of Palm Purée: Hearts of palm (oven roasted, then blended), Chicken stock, Salt

Caramelized Shallots: Shallots, Turmeric oil, Tarragon, Salt, Pepper, Chinese wine

Pan Finish: Shimeji mushrooms

Garnish: Pickled asparagus (specific to this dish)
dishes.serviceNotes: 11-spice rub is warm and aromatic, not hot.

dishes.name: King Crab Uni (Uni Rocoto Butter)
dishes.spielFull: We have an Alaskan king crab leg that is fire roasted and glazed with our uni rocoto butter. You really taste the sweet, oceanic uni, and the Peruvian rocoto chili gives a gentle heat while the butter adds richness. On the side there is a chilled king crab meat salad with root vegetables tossed in a spicy fermented miso vinaigrette, so you get a hot, rich king crab leg and a cool, tangy crab salad to balance it out.
dishes.spielShort: Fire-roasted king crab leg with uni rocoto butter, served with a chilled crab and root vegetable salad in a spicy miso vinaigrette.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Crab Leg & Glaze: Alaskan king crab leg (pre-cooked, fire roasted to order)

Uni Rocoto Butter: Uni, Rocoto sriracha (aji rocoto, Fresno, garlic, palm sugar, salt, vinegar – reduced to a chili sauce), Yuzu kosho, Yellow anticucho (aji amarillo paste, rice vinegar, soy, garlic, lemon, sugar), Light soy sauce, Lime juice, Yuzu juice, Butter, Black pepper (to taste)

Chilled Crab & Root Vegetable Salad: King crab meat, Root vegetables

Gochujang Vinaigrette: Gochujang, Sesame tosazu (sesame oil + tosazu), Tosazu (soy sauce, rice vinegar, bonito, mirin, sugar)

Finish: Chives (finely chopped)
dishes.serviceNotes: Hot crab and chilled salad create a nice temperature and texture contrast.

dishes.name: King Crab Shiso Serrano
dishes.spielFull: We have an Alaskan king crab leg that is seasoned with black pepper, tossed in clarified butter, and fire roasted. Right before it leaves the kitchen, we spoon over our shiso serrano jalapeño dressing, which is garlicky with good acidity and a mild, clean chili heat from the fresh shiso and serrano. On the side there is a chilled king crab meat salad with enoki mushrooms and sugar snap peas tossed in a sesame onion salsa. So you get sweet, meaty crab with a garlicky, vinegary shiso and chili dressing, and a cool, mild crab salad next to it.
dishes.spielShort: Alaskan king crab leg fire roasted in clarified butter, finished with shiso serrano jalapeño dressing, served with a chilled crab, enoki, and sugar snap pea salad in a sesame onion salsa.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Crab Leg: Alaskan king crab leg, Black pepper, Clarified butter

Shiso Serrano Dressing: Jalapeño dressing (Grapeseed oil, Rice vinegar, Jalapeño, Serrano, Garlic), Chopped shiso, Extra fresh serrano (chopped)

Chilled Crab Salad: Crab meat, Enoki mushrooms, Sugar snap peas

Sesame Onion Salsa (Nobu Salsa): Maui onion, Ginger, Garlic, Soy sauce, Rice vinegar, Sesame oil, Yuzu juice, Ichimi togarashi, Sugar
dishes.serviceNotes: Hot-cold contrast with sweet crab, mild chili heat, and a cool, vegetable-forward crab salad.

dishes.name: Umami Chicken
dishes.spielFull: We have a bone-in Jidori chicken breast marinated in our vegetable umami blend - kombu seaweed, shiitake mushroom, soy, and aromatics - then grilled until the outside gets nicely blackened so the marinade caramelizes into a smoky umami crust. It's served over roasted vegetables marinated in a light ginger vinegar spice mix to keep them bright and fresh. We top it with a refreshing kohlrabi salsa and finish with hajikami pickled ginger.
dishes.spielShort: Bone in Jidori chicken breast marinated in kombu, shiitake, and soy vegetable umami blend, grilled and blackened, served with roasted vegetables, kohlrabi salsa, and hajikami pickled ginger.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Bone-in Jidori chicken breast

Umami Vegetable Marinade: Garlic, Ginger, Leeks, Onion, Carrot, Celery, Asparagus, Broccoli, Red bell pepper, Shiitake mushroom, Kombu, Green onion, Cilantro, Parsley, Togarashi, Salt, Soy (soy sauce/soy salt)

Kohlrabi Salsa: Kohlrabi (minced), Ginger, Chive, Ama toza (house sweet vinegar blend: rice vinegar, sugar, salt, soy sauce, bonito, cayenne)

Roasted Vegetables: Cabbage, Celery, Carrots

Veg Marinade for Sides: Vinegar, Ginger, Togarashi, Coriander seed, Mustard seed, White pepper

Finish: Hajikami pickled ginger spear
dishes.serviceNotes: Overall: savory, smoky, and umami-driven with bright, crunchy, acidic elements to keep it light.

dishes.name: Seafood Nabeyaki Udon
dishes.spielFull: We have a seafood nabeyaki udon that's off the menu - a traditional Japanese hot pot with thick white udon noodles, assorted seafood including white fish, salmon, scallop, and shrimp, plus Japanese mushrooms in a savory soy sauce broth infused with bonito and kombu seaweed. We drop in a whole egg to gently poach in the broth, then finish with crispy shrimp tempura on top. It's very comforting and warming.
dishes.spielShort: Seafood nabeyaki udon - traditional Japanese hot pot with thick udon noodles, assorted seafood, Japanese mushrooms, poached egg, finished with shrimp tempura in savory soy sauce broth infused with bonito and kombu seaweed.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Noodles: Udon noodles (thick white wheat noodles)

Seafood: White fish ×2, Salmon ×2, Scallop ×1, Shrimp ×1 (in broth), Shrimp tempura ×1 (on top)

Mushrooms: Shimeji mushrooms, Maitake mushrooms, Enoki mushrooms

Broth: Dashi (Water, Kombu seaweed, Bonito flakes), Soy sauce, Mirin

Egg: Whole egg

Garnish: Shrimp tempura, Scallion (negi), Mitsuba (Japanese herb)

Tempura Batter: Wheat flour, Ice water, Egg
dishes.serviceNotes:
Hot pot and handle are very hot – always warn the guest.

Udon/Nabeyaki broth uses Dashi + soy sauce + mirin, slightly sweeter profile from the mirin.
Clear soup uses Dashi + soy sauce + sake + salt, cleaner, drier, less sweet.

dishes.name: King Crab Udon
dishes.spielFull: We have a king crab udon that is off the menu. It is a pan-glazed king crab udon with white onion and bok choy sautéed in butter. Then we add king crab, build a sweet soy garlic dashi sauce in the pan, and toss thick udon noodles through so they are fully coated in the sauce. From there we transfer everything into a preheated hot pot so it arrives sizzling. We finish with scallion and a Japanese seven-hot spice blend, then drop a raw jidori egg yolk on top for you to break and mix through the noodles for a rich, creamy finish.
dishes.spielShort: Pan-glazed king crab udon with bok choy and white onion in a sweet soy garlic dashi butter sauce, served sizzling in a hot pot with Japanese seven-hot spice, scallion, and a raw jidori egg yolk to mix through for a rich, creamy finish.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Alaskan king crab

Noodles: Udon noodles (half portion)

Vegetables: White onion, Bok choy

Garlic Sweet Soy Sauce: Dashi (water, kombu kelp, bonito), Garlic, Soy sauce, Mirin, Butter

Egg: Raw jidori egg yolk (free-range)

Garnish: Scallion, Shichimi togarashi
dishes.serviceNotes:
Hot pot is extremely hot.
Runner script: 'Careful, very hot. Please break the egg yolk and mix it through the noodles for a creamy finish.'

Garlic sweet soy sauce is unique to this dish — completely different from Short Rib Sauce (Sweet Onion Soy).
Dish replaces Lobster Udon (no longer on menu).

dishes.name: Blue Prawn Salsa Verde
dishes.spielFull: We have Caledonian blue prawns rubbed with our house spice blend, pan seared in butter, then deglazed with sake. We toss them in a yuzu kosho salsa verde - a Japanese citrus pepper salsa that's green, citrusy, spicy, and herb-driven. Served over charred peppery greens dressed with bonito ponzu. Has a good amount of spice.
dishes.spielShort: Szechuan-coriander rubbed Caledonian blue prawn, pan seared in butter, deglazed with sake, then tossed in yuzu kosho salsa verde, over charred peppery greens dressed with bonito ponzu. Bright, savory, with a little heat.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Caledonian blue prawn (3 pieces per order)

Blue Prawn Spice Rub: green pepper, white pepper, mustard seed, coriander seed, Szechuan pepper, dry miso, green togarashi

Yuzu Kosho Salsa Verde: yuzu kosho paste, jalapeño dressing, cilantro

Jalapeño Dressing: grapeseed oil, rice vinegar, jalapeño, garlic, serrano

Peppery Greens: arugula, frisée, mizuna, watercress, butter lettuce

Tosazu: soy sauce, rice vinegar, bonito

Cooking: Butter (for searing prawns), Sake (for deglazing), Olive oil (for grilling greens)

Garnish: Micro cilantro
dishes.serviceNotes:
Same Caledonian blue prawn as Blue Prawn Salad.
Blue Prawn Spice Rub is specific to blue prawn dishes — different from Fish Rub (Szechuan Coriander) used on fish.
'Peppery greens' differentiates from 'spring mix' used on other salads.
Three pieces per order.

dishes.name: Kurodai Black Snapper
dishes.spielFull: Kurodai black snapper rubbed with our Szechuan coriander fish rub and grilled, served with roasted Brussels sprouts tossed in a tomatillo salsa, then finished with micro cilantro and a grilled lemon to squeeze over the top. It is similar to a branzino preparation, but the fish is a little firmer and the rub gives it a gentle Szechuan spice instead of an Mediterranean herbs.
dishes.spielShort: Grilled Kurodai black snapper with Szechuan coriander rub, roasted Brussels sprouts in tomatillo salsa, finished with micro cilantro and a grilled lemon. Similar to branzino but a bit firmer with gentle Szechuan spice.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Kurodai black snapper (whole fish)

Szechuan Coriander Rub: Szechuan pepper, black pepper, dry orange peel, cumin, cayenne, oregano, marjoram, thyme, parsley, dry shallot

Brussels Sprouts: Roasted

Tomatillo Salsa: tomatillos, jalapeño, cilantro, kelp dressing, amatoza, salt, pepper, yuzu

Citrus: Grilled lemon wedge

Garnish: Micro cilantro
dishes.serviceNotes:
Lemon should be grilled and served hot with the dish for guests to squeeze at the table.

Branzino comparison: Kurodai is firmer and rubbed with Szechuan coriander rather than herb-stuffed.
Brussels sprouts are roasted, not crispy flash-fried.
Szechuan Coriander Rub is the same 'Fish Rub' used on NZ Snapper, Tai Red Pepper, King Salmon Rocoto, and other whole fish preparations.

dishes.name: Tai Red Pepper
dishes.spielFull: Japanese red snapper fillet rubbed with our Szechuan-coriander spice blend and pan seared in butter. We plate over a fire-roasted red pepper sauce — quite spicy with a nice smoky character — then add sautéed spinach tossed in a bright cherry tomato vinaigrette for a gentle acidity to balance the heat, and set the fish right on top. Firmer white fish with good heat, but well balanced from the vinaigrette and greens.
dishes.spielShort: Japanese red snapper, Szechuan-coriander rubbed and pan seared in butter, plated over a spicy fire-roasted red pepper sauce with sautéed spinach in cherry tomato vinaigrette for a gentle acidity to balance the heat.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Japanese snapper fillet (Tai)

Szechuan Coriander Rub / Fish Rub: black pepper, Szechuan pepper, dry orange peel, dry lemon peel, cumin, cayenne, oregano, marjoram, thyme, parsley, dry shallot

Roasted Red Pepper Sauce: Fresno pepper, red bell pepper, garlic, light soy sauce, fish sauce, honey, rice wine vinegar

Sautéed Spinach

Cherry Tomato Vinaigrette: cherry tomatoes, lime juice, tosazu, amatoza, fish sauce, serrano, salt, pepper

Cooking: Butter (for pan searing fish)
dishes.serviceNotes:
Roasting technique (charring until fully black, then peeling clean) gives the sauce its signature smoky character.
Good guest line: 'Smoky red pepper sauce built from fire-roasted peppers'.

Cherry tomato vinaigrette is the same used on NZ Snapper (with bok choy) — bright, tangy, with a serrano kick.

dishes.name: New Zealand Snapper
dishes.spielFull: We have a whole New Zealand snapper that is rubbed with our Szechuan coriander fish rub, lightly dusted in potato starch, then flash fried so the skin turns crisp while the flesh stays tender. On the side you get bok choy that is steamed first, then finished on the grill and tossed in a spicy cherry tomato vinaigrette for a bright, tangy contrast. It also comes with a caramelized lemon that is dusted with pink, white, and black peppercorns, marjoram, and a little sugar. When you squeeze that over at the table you get a smoky peppercorn aroma and it really opens up the flavor of the fish. Overall it is a fairly simple preparation that keeps the focus on the natural flavor of the New Zealand snapper with just enough spice and acidity from the bok choy and lemon to balance it.
dishes.spielShort: Whole New Zealand snapper rubbed with Szechuan coriander and flash fried crisp, served with steamed then grilled bok choy in cherry tomato vinaigrette and a peppercorn dusted caramelized lemon to squeeze over.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Whole New Zealand snapper

Szechuan Coriander Rub / Fish Rub: black pepper, Szechuan pepper, dry orange peel, dry lemon peel, cumin, cayenne, oregano, marjoram, thyme, parsley, dry shallot

Coating: Potato starch

Bok Choy: Steamed then grilled

Cherry Tomato Vinaigrette: cherry tomatoes, lime juice, tosazu, amatoza, fish sauce, serrano, salt, pepper

Caramelized Lemon: pink peppercorns, white peppercorns, black peppercorns, marjoram, sugar
dishes.serviceNotes:
Point out the caramelized lemon and tell guests they can squeeze it over the fish to open up the flavor.
Cherry tomato vinaigrette is the same one used on Tai Red Pepper, so it is bright and tangy with a little serrano kick.
Bok choy is steamed first and then grilled, so it has both tenderness and a bit of char.

The fish is technically deep fried, not 'flash fried.' You can still use 'flash fried' in the guest facing spiel if the team prefers that wording.

dishes.name: NZ Snapper Honey Anticucho
dishes.spielFull: We have a whole New Zealand snapper that's rubbed with smoked paprika, ginger, garlic, and white pepper, deboned and cut into bite-size pieces, then coated in a light tempura batter and deep fried until crisp. We flash-fry Brussels sprouts and Fresno peppers separately, then toss everything together in our house honey anticucho sauce - a Peruvian-style sweet and spicy sauce with red and yellow anticucho, honey, and a touch of mayo for creaminess. It has a good kick that's balanced by the honey. We pile all the crispy pieces back over the fried head, spine, and tail so it still looks like a whole fish when it arrives. It looks impressive and tastes even better.
dishes.spielShort: Whole New Zealand snapper rubbed with smoked paprika, tempura fried in bite-size pieces, tossed with Brussels sprouts and Fresno peppers in honey anticucho sauce - sweet, spicy with a good kick, served over the whole fish frame.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Whole New Zealand snapper (deboned, cut into bite-size pieces, bones reserved for plating)

Snapper Rub: smoked paprika, garlic, ginger, white pepper

Tempura Batter: tempura flour, eggs, water

Vegetables: Brussels sprouts (flash fried, no batter, no seasoning), Fresno peppers (flash fried, no batter, no seasoning)

House Honey Anticucho Sauce: red anticucho, yellow anticucho, honey, mayonnaise

Red Anticucho: grapeseed oil, rice vinegar, sake, aji panka, garlic, salt, cumin, oregano

Yellow Anticucho: grapeseed oil, rice vinegar, soy sauce, aji amarillo, yuzu juice, lemon juice

Finish: Smoked paprika powder (for garnish)
dishes.serviceNotes:
Call out that it is the same whole New Zealand snapper, just in a dressed, crispy version that is more sauce driven.
Mention that it is sweet and spicy with a good amount of kick so nobody is surprised.
Let guests know it is already deboned and cut into bite size pieces, even though it is presented over the whole fish frame.

dishes.name: Wagyu Gyoza
dishes.spielFull: We have Nobu-style gyoza dumplings filled with Japanese A5 wagyu and our house-made kimchi. We pan-sear them for a crispy bottom, then steam to lock in all the juices. They're dressed with tosazu - our bonito soy vinegar - mixed with chili oil, and finished with chili flakes, crispy garlic chips, and Tokyo negi. You get rich wagyu, a little kimchi tang, and savory heat from the chili oil.
dishes.spielShort: Nobu gyoza dumplings filled with A5 wagyu and house-made kimchi, pan-seared and steamed, dressed with tosazu chili oil, finished with chili flakes, garlic chips, Tokyo negi.
dishes.completeIngredients:
House-Made Kimchi Filling (ferment 3 days): Napa cabbage, daikon radish, negi, garlic, apple, pear, fish sauce, chili flakes, mochiko powder

Wagyu Filling: Japanese A5 wagyu mixed with ginger, soy sauce, brown sugar, negi, katakuriko

Both wagyu and kimchi are folded together into the dumpling

Tosazu Chili Oil (for plating): Tosazu (rice vinegar, bonito, soy sauce), Chili oil, Sesame oil

Garnishes: Chili flakes, Crispy garlic chips, Tokyo negi
dishes.serviceNotes:
Two-step cook is essential: pan sear then steam to capture the juices inside the gyoza rather than drying them out.
House-made kimchi is fermented 3 days.
Both wagyu and kimchi are inside each dumpling for a rich, complex filling.
Wrapper is wonton shell — same as the tacos.

dishes.name: Okinawa Japanese Purple Sweet Potato
dishes.spielFull: We have a Japanese purple sweet potato that we roast over oak wood chips so it picks up a delicate smoky aroma, then finish it in the broiler. After broiling, we toss it in clarified butter so the outside gets a light glaze and finish it with sea salt. It is naturally sweet and earthy with a gentle touch of smoke and a rich butter finish.
dishes.spielShort: Japanese purple sweet potato roasted over oak, lightly glazed in clarified butter and finished with sea salt. Naturally sweet, earthy, and gently smoky.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Japanese purple sweet potato
Clarified butter
Sea salt
Oak wood chips (for smoking)
dishes.serviceNotes:
Serve hot for best texture and aroma.
Pure potato — no sugar, no dressing, no caramelization.
GRILL = heat from below, ROAST = dry heat all around (oven or over wood), BROIL = high heat from above.

dishes.name: Karaage Chicken
dishes.spielFull: Nobu-style Japanese fried chicken, half jidori chicken brined for 24 hours in spiced vodka with chili, garlic, and ginger, then air-dried for 24 hours before we coat it in our house-made harissa tempura batter and fry it extra crisp. Served with our house aji limo hot sauce, think of it like our Peruvian tabasco, vinegar-forward with serious heat. Six pieces, crisp outside, juicy inside. Only available on the weekend.
dishes.spielShort: Half jidori chicken, 24-hour spiced vodka brine, air-dried 24 hours, coated in house-made harissa tempura batter, fried extra crisp. Served with house aji limo hot sauce, our Peruvian tabasco. Weekend special.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Half jidori chicken, 6 pieces (breast x3, thigh x1, leg x1, wing x1)

Spiced Vodka Brine (24 hours): Vodka, chili, garlic, ginger, salt, water — The vodka helps the aromatics penetrate deeper into the meat and keeps the chicken incredibly moist inside when fried

House-Made Harissa Tempura Batter (no egg, made specifically for this dish): Tempura flour, harissa, marash, katakuriko, chile de arbol, cayenne

House Aji Limo Hot Sauce (our house-made tabasco): Aji limo, star anise, Japanese salt, rice vinegar, garlic, palm sugar — Vinegar-forward with serious Peruvian heat
dishes.serviceNotes:
Weekend special only — 48-hour process requires advance prep.
Half jidori chicken, 6 pieces: More volume than typical dishes — breast x3, thigh x1, leg x1, wing x1.
Spiced vodka brine: Vodka carries the spice flavors deeper into the meat and keeps it moist and tender through frying.
24-hour rest after brine: Not to dry the chicken out, but to bring it to just the right moisture level for the batter to coat properly.

dishes.name: Scallop Bibimbap
dishes.spielFull: Scallop bibimbap is a rice dish served in a hot pot with seven grain rice. We grill the scallops and toss them in our creamy sesame chili sauce, then set them over rice in a hot pot with a new style oil blend of sesame and olive oil so the bottom turns crisp. We lightly torch the scallops in the hot pot for a gentle smoky note, then finish with our house made toasted seaweed rice seasoning, smelt egg, and chive. It is creamy and sesame forward with mild spice and a subtle smokiness, and it is one of our rare rice dishes that does not come from the sushi kitchen.
dishes.spielShort: Grilled scallops with creamy sesame chili sauce over 7 grain rice in a hot pot, lightly torched, then finished with toasted seaweed rice seasoning, smelt egg, and chive.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Protein: Scallops (3 pieces, each cut into 4 bites = 12 total)

Rice Base: White rice (2 cups), Seven-grain rice (1 cup)

Oil Blend (New-Style): sesame oil, olive oil

Creamy Sesame Chili Sauce: mayonnaise, rocoto sriracha, sesame oil, aji panka pepper

Rocoto Sriracha: fresh rocoto peppers, red jalapeño, garlic, Japanese salt, palm sugar, white rice vinegar

House Toasted Seaweed Rice Seasoning: toasted nori seaweed, sesame seeds, sugar, salt, sesame oil — SAME SEASONING FROM TUNA CHIRASHI

Garnish: Masago (smelt egg roe), Chive
dishes.serviceNotes:
Hot pot is extremely hot, advise guest.
As a runner, tell the guest to mix everything well before eating, breaking up the scallops and lifting the crispy rice from the bottom.

Rice ratio: 2 cups white rice to 1 cup seven grain rice (produces about 3 servings per batch).
Rice production is approximately 8 orders per night (less than 10).
House toasted seaweed rice seasoning: use the house blend, not commercial furikake.
Creamy sesame chili sauce is similar to creamy spicy or spicy mayo, but with sesame oil and more depth of flavor because it uses house made rocoto sriracha.
Same oil blend as New Style Sashimi.

dishes.name: Pumpkin Pie
dishes.spielFull: House-baked pumpkin pie topped with white chocolate vanilla ganache — a smooth, creamy white chocolate vanilla pastry cream — and finished with pine nut pumpkin seed crumble sprinkled over the top. Served with espresso gelato on the side. Warm autumn spice balanced by a rich coffee note from the gelato. It's our seasonal special, available only for a short period.
dishes.spielShort: House-baked pumpkin pie topped with white chocolate vanilla ganache and pine nut pumpkin seed crumble, served with espresso gelato on the side.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Pie Crust (same as Apple Pie): AP flour, eggs, almond flour, butter, sugar

Pumpkin Filling: AP flour, pumpkin, sugar, butter, pine nuts, coconut, almond

White Chocolate Vanilla Ganache: Gelatin, sugar, cream, vanilla beans, white chocolate

Pine Nut Pumpkin Seed Crumble: Pine nuts, pumpkin seeds

Espresso Gelato: Served on the side
dishes.serviceNotes:
Seasonal off-menu special.
White Chocolate Vanilla Ganache: A smooth, creamy pastry cream made with white chocolate, vanilla beans, cream, sugar, and gelatin — adds a rich, luxurious finish.
Espresso gelato is plated on a bed of crumble.

dishes.name: Nobu-Style Mandarin Yuzu Kakigori
dishes.spielFull: Our Nobu-style Japanese kakigori is a citrus-forward shaved ice layered with mandarin and yuzu syrup, served over a scoop of vanilla gelato for a creamy base. Finished with dulce de leche pearls, mandarin crunch, and plain frozen mandarin and lemon segments, then drizzled again with mandarin yuzu syrup. It's bright and refreshing like traditional kakigori, but with more richness and texture from the gelato and crunchy toppings.
dishes.spielShort: Nobu-style kakigori shaved ice layered with mandarin and yuzu syrup over vanilla gelato, topped with dulce de leche pearls, mandarin crunch, and frozen mandarin and lemon segments, finished with a final syrup drizzle.
dishes.completeIngredients:
Base: Vanilla gelato (1 scoop)

Shaved Ice and Syrup: Kakigori shaved ice, Mandarin yuzu syrup

Toppings: Dulce de leche pearls, Mandarin crunch, Frozen mandarin segments (plain, no sugar or seasoning), Frozen lemon segments (plain, no sugar or seasoning)
dishes.serviceNotes:
Positioning line for guests: 'Traditional kakigori, but more dessert-like because of the gelato and crunchy toppings.'
If a guest wants lighter desserts, mention it's refreshing, but slightly richer than the previous kakigori.

dishes.name: Silk & Ember
dishes.spielFull: I wanted to mention one cocktail that is off the menu. It is called Silk and Ember and it drinks like a Nobu Malibu style Japanese holiday Old Fashioned. We start with Armagnac brandy, which is a very elegant, spice driven style of brandy, and stir it with a dry Japanese sake vermouth, a little allspice liqueur, and our Japanese black sugar syrup infused with cinnamon and clove that we make in house. Then we add a couple dashes of cocoa bitters and serve it over a single large Nobu stamped rock, finished with torched rosemary and a fresh cranberry on top. You get rosemary smoke on the nose and rich baking spice, caramel and a hint of chocolate on the palate, so it has all the holiday vibes if you are in the mood for a spirit forward Nobu Malibu holiday cocktail.
dishes.spielShort: So we have something special off the menu—it's a Nobu-style Japanese holiday Old Fashioned. Armagnac instead of whiskey, sake vermouth, Jamaican allspice liqueur, house-made honey syrup with cinnamon and clove. We torch rosemary and a cranberry on top. All the holiday vibes in one cup, and it's definitely spirit-forward.
dishes.completeIngredients:
2 oz Cardinal du Four Armagnac Blanc
0.5 oz Oka Kura Dry Bermutto (Japanese sake vermouth)
0.25 oz St. Elizabeth Allspice Dram
0.25 oz House-made Japanese Honey Syrup (Momotaro Kuromitsu base infused with cinnamon and clove)
2 dashes Angostura Cocoa Bitters
1 Large Ice Cube (Nobu-stamped)
1 Fresh Rosemary Sprig
1 Fresh Cranberry

House-Made Japanese Honey Syrup: 12.6 oz Momotaro Kuromitsu (Japanese black sugar syrup), 2 oz Acqua Panna or filtered water, 6 Cinnamon Sticks, 2 Cloves — Simmer all ingredients for 7 minutes, cool completely, store in squeeze bottle for up to 2 weeks.
dishes.serviceNotes:
Build Method: Pour 2 oz Cardinal du Four Armagnac into stirring tin, add 0.5 oz Oka Kura Dry Bermutto, add 0.25 oz St. Elizabeth Allspice Dram, add 0.25 oz house-made Japanese honey syrup, add 2 dashes Angostura Cocoa Bitters, add draft ice & stir (30 seconds), strain, add ice to glass (Nobu-stamped large cube), garnish – Rosemary Torch (3-5 seconds until smoking, perch cranberry on rosemary).

December Cocktail of the Month.
